1) 5+ years of Java development experience 
 2) Experience with MySQL or Oracle backend
 3) Experience with REST webservices 
 Job Description: 
 Sun Power is looking for a senior java developer to join their existing team. The Spectrum application sells and manages solar panel systems. This is a high profile project for SunPower and as they plan to grow their independent dealer teams from 10 to 400 by EOY. Spectrum is a sales tool used by the sales organization to help sell solar panels. The application creates proposals, sales orders, manages leads, handles ordering and installation and is the main customer relations tool.  
 SunPower purchased the company July 2014 and is used by all their independent dealers for sales, procurement and accounting. The original team was 4 dev and 1QA, now the team is 4-6 dev with 2 QA. SunPower has put a lot of money into making the application more scalable for hundreds of dealers they are adding and is the 2nd most important initiative for SunPower R&D. 

 The application was architected and built 4-5 years ago and has been maintained since then. The team is going to redesign some of the application as well as add software which would allow the sales organization to add engineering documents similar to CAD. This would allow the buyer and sales person to see how the solar panels would look on a house roof.  

 Candidates should meet the following criteria: 

 -5+ years of java development experience 
 -Experience with REST web services
 -Experience with Eclipse IDE
 -Experience wtih MySQL
 Nice to have: 

 -Maven
 -Jenkins
 -Agile
 -Jira 
 Additional Information: 
 The application is built on MySQL, EJB, JBoss application server, GUI and GWT on the front end. The Javascript is not touched. The application is written as an app, not a series of web pages. It’s highly interactive, stayfull screens and it’s constantly communicating through services  
 Work Environment: 
 Sun Power is a relaxed, but deadline driven environment. Nate is flexible on work hours and many developers come in between 8-10am. Dress code is relaxed and jean/polo is appropriate.  



 
 Good comm skills are a big priority 
 Duration: 6+ months
